hack2hire:68f5af31a269f53ea0eff8a0.reference: per group, copy the scores, sort them in decreasing order and add the first k
hack2hire:68f5af31a269f53ea0eff8a0.candidate_design: per group, keep a size-k min-heap of scores (push, pop the smallest when larger than k) and sum the heap; compare totals with a strict greater-than so the first best index wins
hack2hire:68f5af31a269f53ea0eff8a0.complexity_target: O(G log k) time/O(k) extra space, G = total group size

hack2hire:677f3733edc5bbd98ac0ea5a.reference: for each distinct plate, rescan the whole record list and add the fee between each pass and the previous pass of that plate
hack2hire:677f3733edc5bbd98ac0ea5a.candidate_design: one pass with a dictionary from plate to (last position, total); extract the number from each name by skipping its letters; sort the plates at the end
hack2hire:677f3733edc5bbd98ac0ea5a.complexity_target: O(n log n) time for the final sort/O(n) space

hack2hire:677de134052a260e01657068.reference: for every peak position, try every peak height from the largest that fits the array ends downwards and check every block cell directly
hack2hire:677de134052a260e01657068.candidate_design: the largest peak at c is min(c + 1, n - c, min over i of arr[i] + |i - c|); compute the inner minimum with one left-to-right and one right-to-left pass and subtract the best k * k from sum(arr)

hack2hire:67873a44e20f8f324213c29a.reference: enumerate every non-decreasing target array between power and max(power), price the increments d by sum of max(0, d[i] - d[i - 1]) and keep the cheapest
hack2hire:67873a44e20f8f324213c29a.candidate_design: every drop power[i - 1] > power[i] needs operations starting at i worth at least the drop, and raising suffixes achieves exactly that; sum the drops

hack2hire:69a357a36e73e4abccc9bf9c.candidate_design: keep a row order permutation and one reversed flag per original row; a swap exchanges two permutation entries and a reversal flips a flag, then build the result once at the end

hack2hire:67a4d4ca2a9ed767fa215433.reference: try every sign assignment (a[0] must be plus) and keep the largest number of minus signs whose prefix sums all stay positive
hack2hire:67a4d4ca2a9ed767fa215433.candidate_design: scan left to right, tentatively negate every element and push it on a max-heap; while the running sum is not positive, flip the largest negated value back to plus; the heap size at the end is the answer

hack2hire:67735a0732f9cd104fc349d4.reference: sort the durations and simulate min(n * m, number of tasks) slot end times in a plain list, scanning the list for the earliest-free slot for every task
hack2hire:67735a0732f9cd104fc349d4.candidate_design: sort the durations and keep the slot end times in a min-heap of size min(n * m, number of tasks); pop the earliest, stop when it plus the duration exceeds 60, otherwise push the new end time

hack2hire:6a57ce72665efda9311f94c4.reference: enumerate every path from (0, p) depth first and keep the largest sum
hack2hire:6a57ce72665efda9311f94c4.candidate_design: row-by-row dynamic programme of the best sum reaching each cell from (0, p), with unreachable cells marked, then the maximum over the bottom row

hack2hire:6a57d29e665efda9311f950a.reference: enumerate every path from (0, p) depth first with the remaining jump count and keep the largest sum
hack2hire:6a57d29e665efda9311f950a.candidate_design: dynamic programme over (row, column, jumps used): best sum reaching each state, filled row by row from the one-row moves of row i - 1 and the jumps of row i - 2

hack2hire:6a57d9ca665efda9311f954c.reference: enumerate every path from (0, p) depth first with its cell list and keep the largest sum, then the smallest list on equal sums
hack2hire:6a57d9ca665efda9311f954c.candidate_design: backward dynamic programme of the best sum from (i, j) with r jumps left to the bottom row; then walk forward from (0, p), at each step taking the first move in cell order (down-left, down, down-right, jump) whose state keeps the optimum

hack2hire:6a57dafb665efda9311f9556.reference: enumerate every path from (0, p) depth first, keep the largest sum and count the paths that reach it
hack2hire:6a57dafb665efda9311f9556.candidate_design: forward dynamic programme over (row, column, jumps used) storing (best sum, number of paths with that sum mod 1000000007); merge predecessors by keeping the larger sum and adding counts on equal sums, then merge the bottom-row states the same way

hack2hire:67874b97e20f8f324213c29c.reference: quadratic dynamic programme over prefix lengths, trying every last-shipment start and computing its maximum directly
hack2hire:67874b97e20f8f324213c29c.candidate_design: a shipment ending at i is balanced exactly when it starts at or before g(i), the nearest earlier index with a larger weight (monotonic stack); best[i + 1] = 1 + max(best[0..g(i)]), using a running prefix maximum of best

hack2hire:68c4484970268e95f5f43d5e.reference: compute every reachable set by breadth-first search; a server is needed in a source class when every server reaching it is reachable from it; count those mutual-reachability classes
hack2hire:68c4484970268e95f5f43d5e.candidate_design: iterative Tarjan strongly connected components, then count components with no incoming edge from another component
